mapper.select: SELECT FAV_ID, MEMBER_NO, FAV_TYPE, TARGET_ID, REG_DATE, TITLE, PRICE, IMAGE_URL, LINK, WISH_KEY FROM ( SELECT f.FAV_ID, f.MEMBER_NO, f.FAV_TYPE, f.TARGET_ID, f.REG_DATE, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS TITLE, NVL(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.SALE_PRICE, '[^0-9]', '')), 0) AS PRICE, img.FILE_URL AS IMAGE_URL, '/store/detail?id=' || TO_CHAR(p.PRODUCT_ID) AS LINK, 'store:' || TO_CHAR(p.PRODUCT_ID) AS WISH_KEY FROM TB_FAVORITE f JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = f.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REF_ID, FILE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY REF_ID ORDER BY FILE_ID) AS RN FROM TB_FILE WHERE REF_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' ) img ON img.REF_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID AND img.RN = 1 WHERE f.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND f.FAV_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' UNION ALL SELECT f.FAV_ID, f.MEMBER_NO, f.FAV_TYPE, f.TARGET_ID, f.REG_DATE, s.NAME AS TITLE, NVL((SELECT MIN(r.PRICE_PER_NIGHT) FROM TB_STAY_ROOM r WHERE r.STAY_ID = s.STAY_ID AND r.STATUS_CD = 'APPROVE'), 0) AS PRICE, img.FILE_URL AS IMAGE_URL, '/stay/detail?id=' || TO_CHAR(s.STAY_ID) AS LINK, 'stay:' || TO_CHAR(s.STAY_ID) AS WISH_KEY FROM TB_FAVORITE f JOIN TB_STAY s ON s.STAY_ID = f.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REF_ID, FILE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY REF_ID ORDER BY FILE_ID) AS RN FROM TB_FILE WHERE REF_TYPE = 'STAY' ) img ON img.REF_ID = s.STAY_ID AND img.RN = 1 WHERE f.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND f.FAV_TYPE IN ('LODGE', 'STAY') UNION ALL SELECT f.FAV_ID, f.MEMBER_NO, f.FAV_TYPE, f.TARGET_ID, f.REG_DATE, h.NAME AS TITLE, 0 AS PRICE, img.FILE_URL AS IMAGE_URL, '/hospital/detail?id=' || TO_CHAR(h.HOSPITAL_ID) AS LINK, 'hospital:' || TO_CHAR(h.HOSPITAL_ID) AS WISH_KEY FROM TB_FAVORITE f JOIN TB_HOSPITAL h ON h.HOSPITAL_ID = f.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REF_ID, FILE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY REF_ID ORDER BY FILE_ID) AS RN FROM TB_FILE WHERE REF_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' ) img ON img.REF_ID = h.HOSPITAL_ID AND img.RN = 1 WHERE f.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND f.FAV_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' ) x ORDER BY x.REG_DATE DESC, x.FAV_ID DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN FAV_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' THEN 'store:' || TO_CHAR(TARGET_ID) WHEN FAV_TYPE IN ('LODGE', 'STAY') THEN 'stay:' || TO_CHAR(TARGET_ID) WHEN FAV_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' THEN 'hospital:' || TO_CHAR(TARGET_ID) ELSE FAV_TYPE || ':' || TO_CHAR(TARGET_ID) END FROM TB_FAVORITE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
